title: A Proximal Gradient Framework for Composite Multiobjective Optimization on Riemannian Manifolds
summary: This paper proposes a Riemannian Multiobjective Proximal Gradient Method (RMPGM) for composite optimization problems on manifolds. Unlike scalarization-based approaches, the proposed framework directly handles vector-valued objectives and establishes global convergence to Pareto stationary points, together with an $\mathcal{O}(1/k)$ convergence rate.
